title: Hosted API feature qualification heuristics for enterprise streaming, tool calls, and structured output
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: define a concise, repeatable qualification and prioritization heuristic for enterprise-sourced Hosted API feature requests that involve chat streaming, function/tool calling, and structured outputs. Goal is to reduce intake latency, surface SLA/compliance requirements early, and route requests to the correct delivery path (self-serve, SE-assisted, Dedicated/Private sales + engineering). This ticket captures the proposed heuristic, edge cases, and examples from recent inbound requests.
acceptance_criteria: A documented heuristic that returns: (1) eligibility (yes/no), (2) priority score 0-100, (3) recommended route (self-serve/SE-assisted/Dedicated/Private), and (4) required follow-ups (security/compliance, dataproduct, infra).
Heuristic includes explicit handling for: streaming chat with tool chains, multi-function tool calls, structured outputs (JSON schemas), and data residency/SLA constraints.
At least three real inbound requests are run through the heuristic in this ticket and show expected routing decisions.
Stakeholder review sign-off from Product, Security, and Solutions Engineering recorded in comments.
A short intake form template and Playbook snippet is created and attached (links in 'links').
comments: 2025-02-10 Aisha Patel: Ticket created after backlog review — multiple enterprise customers asked for guaranteed streaming + function-calling SLAs plus structured output guarantees. Request: reduce back-and-forth and speed triage to <72h.

2025-02-12 Marco Ruiz: Drafted initial heuristic matrix. Suggest combining customer_impact * SLA_multiplier - estimated_engineering_effort to arrive at priority score. Added cost sensitivity and compliance multiplier.

2025-02-14 Priya Menon (Security): Flag: any request with PII residency or KMS requirement must automatically route to Private/Dedicated lane and include security assessment. Marked as security_review_required.
2025-02-17 Nate Cole (Solutions Eng): Feedback: emphasize integration complexity for toolchains with external webhooks and retry semantics. Proposed a new 'operational-risk' subscore.
2025-02-20 Marco Ruiz: Updated heuristic to include 'operational-risk' and 'observability-gap' as explicit multipliers. Added sample scoring for 3 requests (see links).
2025-02-24 Product review meeting: PM, SE, Security and Engineering agreed on the high-level formula. Action: run pilot on last 8 inbound enterprise requests and refine thresholds.
2025-02-28 Aisha Patel: Submitted for design of intake form and automation mapping. Requesting approval to schedule automation with Intake Automation (ENG-1879).
decisions: Use a single blended priority score (0-100) composed of: customer_impact (0-40), SLA_urgency (0-20), compliance_multiplier (0.5-2.0), operational_risk (0-20), and engineering_estimate_penalty (0-20).
Requests with compliance_multiplier > 1.5 or SLA_urgency >= 15 route to SE-assisted intake with mandatory security assessment.

Self-serve eligibility requires: no cross-region data residency needs, no external webhook chaining with secrets exposure, and structured-output schema <= 5 fields or clearly mappable to Redwood’s existing JSON templates.
All streaming + function-calling requests that declare 'enterprise SLA' are flagged for Dedicated capacity evaluation if priority score >= 70.
Automation: initial version will be manual scoring in the intake spreadsheet; next step is to encode thresholds into Intake Automation (ENG-1879).
next_steps: Complete pilot run of 8 inbound requests and capture outcomes (assigned to Marco, due 2025-03-03).
Design a short intake form (3-6 questions) that surfaces: data residency, SLA target, functions toolchain diagram, structured schema sample. (Design: Priya, due 2025-03-05).
Work with ENG-1879 to prototype automated scoring based on the spreadsheet thresholds (Engineering kickoff 2025-03-06).
Add intake playbook to Solutions Eng onboarding and create 1-pager for AE/CS teams. (PM owner: Aisha).
